actual_source_changes.summary: Implemented deterministic topic inventory coverage and worker invariant engine with finite executable proof suite, integrated into portable ledger recovery and continuation completion boundaries.

files_created.description: Deterministic coverage and inventory invariant engine. Additive reconciliation of all baseline sources, dropped task detection, live native roster classification (useful running/idle vs parked/fake), 7-15 worker floor enforcement with RAM ceiling exception (>=95%), and actionable NextAssignment generation prioritizing 1 worker per runnable topic.

Comprehensive contract test suite with finite executable proofs for all 7 acceptance criteria (remove item fails, park only worker fails, completion produces next assignment, blocked topic stays present, 7 workers satisfy floor, fake active statuses fail, restored inventory loses zero tasks).

files_modified.description: Added RequestLedger.check_topic_coverage() method and CLI 'topic-coverage' subcommand with --sources, --roster-json, --ram-pct, --strict, and --json flags.

Extended DriverOutcome with next_assignments and coverage_summary fields; integrated topic coverage evaluation at step completion/run finish boundary; formatted next actionable assignments in terminal summary.
Registered topic_inventory_guard.py in portable workflow module catalog with inputs, outputs, CLI command, and invariant role.

install_and_adapter_steps.policy_boundary: No installed runtime replacement until Main verifies (files remain isolated on branch feat/topic-inventory-coverage-guard).
host_adapter_integration: Orchestrator (Main) queries live native roster using irc(op='list') or session broker.
Passes live roster to guard: guard.evaluate_topic_coverage(inventory=reconciled, roster=actual_roster, ram_used_pct=current_ram).
Consumes report.next_assignments to dispatch newly uncovered runnable topics (prioritizing 1 worker per runnable topic before secondary workers).
Dispatches workers under 'fast' primary execution lane (google-antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash:high) per profile policy.
Consumes live native statuses ('running' / 'idle') rather than trusting static 'owner' strings on task cards.

finite_executable_proof_results.observed_behavior: Dropping an item from baseline inventory results in report.ok=False with an explicit DROPPED_TASK violation naming the exact item ID and content.

finite_executable_proof_results.criterion: park only worker of runnable topic -> fails
finite_executable_proof_results.observed_behavior: When the only assigned worker for a runnable topic is parked, report.ok=False with an UNCOVERED_RUNNABLE_TOPIC violation, proving parked workers do not count as active.
Upon task completion, guard immediately produces NextAssignment recommendation for the next runnable task in that topic with recommended role 'fast' and acceptance criteria.

Topics with explicit blocker reasons (e.g. missing operator credentials) are recognized as blocked and excluded from runnable coverage requirements, while retaining all tasks in total inventory (zero tasks silently deleted).
When 7 real active workers cover independent runnable topics, report.floor_satisfied=True, report.active_workers_count=7, and zero WORKER_FLOOR_DEFICIT violations are emitted.

Prepared tickets ('prepared'), reminder daemons ('reminder_daemon'), simulated active statuses ('simulated_active'), and fake entries are rejected with FAKE_WORKER_REJECTED violations and do not count toward the active worker total, resulting in floor deficit failure.

Additive reconciliation across full-topic-board-current.json, scope-additive-verification.json, open-issue-inventory.json, and ledger.json preserves all 342 board tasks (365 unique across all sources). Illustrative-A choice is preserved as cancelled with operator clarification reason, not restored as pending. Zero tasks dropped.

deterministic_checker.role: Deterministic invariant validator and assignment generator.
capabilities: Audits against dropped or missing task content.
Enforces strict classification of active vs parked vs fake worker states.
Applies mathematical floor checks (7-15) and capacity exceptions (RAM >= 95%).
deterministic_checker.limitations: Runs purely as Python code; cannot directly invoke host task tools, fork OS processes, or guarantee runtime machine state without host cooperation.

live_host_enforcement.role: Runtime process execution, task dispatch, and physical state management.
capabilities: Executes tool.task to spawn native background subagents.
Maintains live IRC communications and task event loops.
Allocates and monitors host memory, PTY streams, and OS processes.
Applies live operator instructions and permission gates.
live_host_enforcement.boundary: Host enforcement relies on the checker for audit and recommendation, but the checker cannot replace host process supervisor responsibilities.

distinction_checker_vs_live_enforcement.cautionary_principle: Passing finite test fixtures confirms algorithmic soundness and fail-closed gate logic, but it does NOT substitute for live end-to-end host verification or justify unmonitored execution. Continuous reconciliation between live session state, GitHub issues, and the disk ledger is mandatory.
